addition.item: Optional HTTP cache policy for local open/download (off / revalidate / public) with ETag, Last-Modified, and HTTP 304. Default remains private no-store; public applies only to guest-accessible documents.

fix.item: HTTP Range parsing rejects invalid Range headers correctly (operator-precedence bug in HttpByteRange). Unsatisfiable ranges now return HTTP 416 explicitly.
Search indexer loads storage_driver and skips external URL documents as skipped instead of repeatedly marking them failed.
Schema update 1.1.4.sql / installer ensure adds folder-batch scan_cursor and aligns #__schemas with the component manifest.
Google Drive access tokens are cached until near expiry independently of site System Cache, and stored encrypted via TokenVault.
Software template GitHub release download counts are cached for three hours independently of site System Cache.
Frontend listing queries no longer select the full description column; listing cards use short_description only.
Folder scan loads the category folder map once per batch and only loads linked file paths under the configured storage root.

Phrase search no longer uses full-index GROUP_CONCAT; content-match ID caps show a notice when hit; indexer chunks overlap for boundary phrases (reindex required); active search sessions survive captcha redirects.
Search session keys moved outside ListModel filter state (fixes listing showing all documents after search); captcha forms block Enter/submit until anti-spam is ready.
Destructive administrator actions now require POST with CSRF token (indexer, backup export, Drive connect/disconnect, folder-batch actions, picker token).
Admin POST action buttons no longer nest a form inside Settings/edit forms (restores Save / Save and Close / Cancel toolbar).
Settings and folder-batch forms keep task at the top of adminForm with a safe submitbutton so toolbar actions cannot lose the task field.
Google Drive OAuth reconnect no longer fails after Connect: single-use state nonce is stored under site tmp/ shared by administrator and site callback.
Folder-batch import resumes from a persisted scan_cursor checkpoint so each batch does not re-walk already-handled files from the start.
Category search/clear fetch a fresh CSRF token from search.security before POST so Cloudflare-cached listing HTML does not reuse a stale form token.
Search security bootstrap uses POST so Cloudflare Cache Everything cannot cache the JSON token/challenge or strip the session Set-Cookie.
Frontend search script asset renamed to site-search-cfpost.js so Cloudflare cannot keep serving a stale cached site-search.js after update.
Captcha search results require URL filter_search and filter_search_mode to match the captcha-approved session; mismatch shows the clean listing.
Without captcha, a clean category URL no longer resurrects a previous search from user-state.
Settings Search tab warns about the required Cloudflare Cache Rule bypass for filter_search.
Search redirects always include filter_search in the URL so result pages do not share the clean category cache key.
Search index save runs in a database transaction; failed index rows are no longer auto-retried until rebuild/pending.
URL size probe blocks private/reserved hosts; Drive Connect requires a CSRF token and OAuth state nonces are single-use.
TokenVault uses authenticated encryption (sodium_crypto_secretbox, v2: prefix); legacy AES-CBC tokens still decrypt and are rewritten to v2 on use.
Local file streaming stops when the client disconnects; download counters ignore Range continuation requests.
Google Drive streaming stops pulling from Google when the client disconnects (connection_aborted in the cURL write callback; Google Docs/Sheets export included).
Google Drive downloads use a 30s connect timeout and abort stalled transfers below 1 KiB/s for 60s (no hard total download timeout on streams).
Category document counts reuse pagination totals; Media adapter hard-denies dangerous extensions; package installer uses createQuery().

note.item: Install and update only through pkg_devartdocuments.

fix.item: Frontend menu lookup no longer filters by MenuItem::client_id. SiteMenu does not expose that property, so getItems(..., 'client_id') produced Undefined property warnings under PHP 8.x (GitHub issue #1).

note.item: Install and update only through pkg_devartdocuments.

fix.item: Dashboard storage protection probe reports the real HTTP status again: the probe used a non-static HTTP factory call that always failed and reported status 0.

Joomla 7 readiness: removed Joomla APIs scheduled for removal in 7.0 (Factory::getConfig, Factory::getCache, application input property, Categories::getInstance, Table::getDbo, view get(), Document addScript/addScriptDeclaration/addStyleDeclaration).

Joomla 7 readiness for plugins: plugins no longer receive the event dispatcher in their constructor, and the system plugin reads form and save events through typed event getters instead of numeric event arguments.
Google Drive and OAuth requests use the Joomla framework HTTP client (PSR-7) instead of the deprecated CMS HTTP client, keeping the Joomla user agent and Global Configuration proxy settings.
Frontend styles and scripts load through the WebAssetManager in views, the module and the content plugin; feed and raw documents no longer attempt to load HTML assets.
Administrator forms and lists load form validation, keepalive and multiselect through the WebAssetManager instead of legacy behavior helpers.
PHP 8.5 readiness: removed deprecated curl_close() and finfo_close() calls and the $http_response_header variable in the anti-spam verification fallback.
Database queries use createQuery() and setLimit() instead of the deprecated getQuery(true) and setQuery() offset/limit arguments.
Search session values are removed with Session::remove() instead of the deprecated Session::clear($key).

note.item: Install and update only through pkg_devartdocuments.

addition.item: Category option Embedded PDF preview for this category: show or hide the embedded preview for every PDF-template document in the category, overriding the per-document toggle.
DevArt Documents tags: own tag manager (DevArt Documents → Tags), tag assignment on the document form, frontend tag pages, and tag filters for menu items and the module.

Module content scope Single document: select and render one published document using the document detail layout, with a searchable DocumentSelect modal picker (Events-aligned, ID/title search, bounded results).

fix.item: ZIP and other package types (docx, xlsx, pptx, rar, 7z, …) upload again: install/update merges Documents defaults into Joomla Media Manager document and restrict-upload lists, and archive MIME validation accepts common OS labels.
Multiple tags can be created and assigned again. Documents no longer use Joomla core tags; the short-lived content type registration from the 1.1.1 development build is removed on update.
Document detail opens when Routing is Off with no Documents menu: attach a non-home layout Itemid so Gantry/Page Content is not suppressed by the Home outline (query URL with Itemid).
Web asset registry paths corrected so registered styles and scripts resolve: media URIs no longer repeat the css/ and js/ folder, which silently discarded the DocumentSelect picker assets.

Category search submit button is no longer permanently disabled when an anti-spam method is active: the search script path was unresolvable, so proof-of-work, reCAPTCHA and Turnstile never enabled the button.
Search results count now shows the full filtered total instead of the current page size (for example 172 matches, not 20).

Media Manager / article image browse no longer sticks on DevArt Documents storage: the Documents filesystem provider registers only for the document file picker (or an explicit Documents adapter path), so normal Media falls back to Local images.

note.item: Install and update only through pkg_devartdocuments.

addition.item: Software display template with optional Changelog, Releases, Documentation, Requirements, Hash, and custom Download label fields.
PDF display template with ACL-gated embedded preview, document version, effective date, and print control.
Editor button DevArt Embed PDF (PDF-only picker) inserting layout=embed shortcodes.
Content shortcode embed layout for ACL-gated inline PDF preview in articles.
Per-extension Open overrides in Tools → Settings.
External URL storage driver (http/https) with ACL-gated redirect open/download.
Document Ordering field for Manual ordering on category menus and modules.
Category and menu display/theme overrides with documented resolution chains.
Shared DocumentEmbedService and common embed template.
Root LICENSE.txt and release housekeeping for public update channel.

change.item: Theme resolution: listing cards use document → menu → category; document detail ignores menu overrides.
Installer admin submenu link normalization reports only when a link actually changes.
PHP file headers aligned to GPLv3+; module and plugin manifests include description tags.
Joomla update metadata aligned with DevArt package pattern (client, changelogurl, targetplatform 6.*).

fix.item: Software/PDF Yes toggles correctly reveal dependent URL, hash, and related input fields.
GitHub help text hidden when the PDF template is selected.
Content plugin loads com_devartdocuments language so article shortcodes show translated button labels.
Google Drive token vault and OAuth hardening (HKDF, host checks, redirect allowlist).
Archive MIME handling without treating application/octet-stream as a safe open type.
Fixed broken el-GR site language quotes and forced frontend language load so button labels are not raw COM_* keys.

note.item: Public update after 1.0.1. Intermediate local builds 1.0.2–1.0.38 are not published separately.
Install and update only through pkg_devartdocuments.

addition.item: First public release for Joomla 6 (PHP 8.3+): document library, categories, ACL, local and Google Drive storage.
Full-text search with optional external MariaDB index, CAPTCHA, rate limits and scheduled indexing.
Folder scan profiles, metadata backup, Media Manager integration and DevArt document card UI.

change.item: Production hardening: centralized MIME validation, HTTP Range for local files, listing indexes.

fix.item: Clean-site package install: installer no longer creates incomplete schema before install SQL.
Installer postflight loads storage and menu helpers without requiring a booted component.
Installer document indexes use Joomla getTableKeys() API.
